requirement: Chinese evidence must be original text from the staged documents and each location must identify the correct document and page.
source_quote:

source_evidence: input/task_brief.md lines 16-17 states: "the original Chinese text that proves the issue" and "a location marker with document name and page number." input/document_manifest.json `documents` contains canonical entries for Document 1 (Announcement), Document 2 (Buyer 1 Report), Document 3 (Buyer 2 Report), and Document 4 (Seller Report), including extracted_text_path and page_count.
evidence: A reproducible parser resolved all 19 evidence bullets through input/document_manifest.json and found all cited page numbers within the declared page counts. It then isolated the corresponding `=== Page N ===` segments and compared 21 quoted excerpts after NFKC Unicode and whitespace normalization. Seventeen excerpts occurred verbatim, but four did not: (1) Finding 1, Document 2 (Buyer 1 Report), Page 12, beginning `四、本次权益变动的资金来源……本次权益变动资金来源`; (2) Finding 3, Document 1 (Announcement), Page 2, beginning `受让方2名称 ... ……转让股份数量`; (3) Finding 4, Document 1 (Announcement), Page 4, beginning `受让方1名称 ... ……法定代表人/执行事务合伙人`; and (4) Finding 5, Document 1 (Announcement), Page 5, beginning `受让方2名称 ... ……法定代表人/执行事务合伙人`. In each case, the inserted `……` joins non-contiguous source text and is not present at that position on the cited extracted-text page.
observed: 17 of 21 quoted excerpts are verbatim on the cited page; 4 of 21 fail the registered normalized-occurrence test because they use inserted ellipses to concatenate source fragments.
expected: Every quoted excerpt is traceable to the stated canonical filing and page in the staged corpus.
repair_hint: Replace each of the four non-contiguous ellipsis quotations with a contiguous verbatim excerpt from the same cited page, or split each into separately quoted contiguous excerpts carrying the same document-and-page marker.
